task: Scoreboard reproduces hand-computed numbers on a synthetic 200-event fixture; short-code minting is unique; Thompson allocation respects the exploration floor

assertions.expected: returns a non-null, non-empty short_code
returns two different short_codes (no collision)
matches https://biddeed.ai/r/{code}

assertions.input: thompson_allocate(n=4) with no prior wins/losses for any archetype
assertions.expected: returns 4 archetypes, all drawn from the 7 defined ARCHETYPES

assertions.input: thompson_allocate(n=4, exploration_floor=1) with all 7 archetypes having observations except one
assertions.expected: the unobserved archetype is included in the result

assertions.input: thompson_allocate(n=4) with one archetype having 10 wins/0 losses and others 0/10
assertions.expected: the 10-win archetype is very likely (seeded rng) in the top picks, but exploration floor still forces >=1 unobserved-style pick when available
returns wins=0, losses=0 for every archetype with no rows, does not crash

assertions.input: synthetic 200-event fixture: 50 plays + 10 clicks + 5 captures for one variant, hand-computed ctr=10/50=0.2
assertions.expected: v_variant_scoreboard.ctr for that variant == 0.2 (within float tolerance)
v_variant_scoreboard.plays == 50
v_variant_scoreboard.captures == 5
v_variant_scoreboard.ctr is null, not a divide-by-zero error
raises NotImplementedError, does not return a fabricated dict

assertions.input: write_weekly_digest with zero decided reel_variant_review rows
assertions.expected: digest text says 'not enough decided variants yet', does not name a fabricated winner
digest names the archetype with the highest approve rate and states n=
matches docs/gtm/reports/{iso_week}.md
explicitly states spi_daily was not written (M2 protected object)
returns a list (possibly empty), queries the live view without error

assertions.input: scoreboard for a specific reel_id with rows
assertions.expected: returns exactly the variants for that reel_id, filtered correctly
mint_variant_short_link still returns code+short_url with qr_url=None, does not raise
calls biddeed_reels_lib.gen_short_code, not a reimplementation
always equals the requested n
uses a LEFT JOIN LATERAL to the most recent reel_variant_review decision per variant, not an unbounded join that double-counts
view is created WITH (security_invoker=true)
(variant_id, day, platform) is unique -- a second insert for the same key updates rather than duplicates

assertions.input: claim 'scoreboard reproduces hand-computed numbers' for the eval harness
assertions.expected: backed by an actual query against a real inserted fixture, not an assumed-correct SQL read
